frozen_scientific_scope.original_scope: Original1000 ribbed evolute ammonite: flat discoidal shell with exposed inner whorls and ribs continuing across rounded outer edge. No soft animal, matrix scene or substitute genus.

scale.measurement_source: p.115 actual dimensions in mm; definition/order p.95, NOT percentages. 59 mm maximum diameter; other values at 57.8 mm diameter. All figures natural size per p.110 caption. No measurement from rescaled PDF pixels.
scale.tolerance: Low-poly design target: diameter 0.057–0.061 m; breadth about 0.015–0.018 m; umbilicus about 0.029–0.033 m. These are engineering tolerances, not biological uncertainty measurements.

uncertainty: Opposite flank is not separately photographed in this figure; approximate bilateral symmetry is an explicit inference from planispiral coiling and the ventral figure. Do not claim mirrored surface damage is observed.
Minor fracture/wear details and fossil palette are artistic simplification. Exact septal sutures/internal chambers are not modeled. Current species synonymy is not independently revised here.

Kevmin photograph is a DIFFERENT unidentified Dactylioceras sp., 40 mm from Germany, used only as secondary real-fossil visual context. Never assign its dimensions, damage, colour or locality to GSM26407.
